parameters.ledger_parameter: mdot_cathode (context for the A5 fixed 0.10 mg/s term; not changed)

evidence.conditions: MaSMi LUC (LaB6, sub-kW Hall class) 'normal cathode operation' after ignition with 2 A to a downstream anode; thruster runs used cathode flow fraction 2-7 % of anode flow, keeper off
evidence.locator: detailed description, heaterless-ignition and cathode I-V paragraphs
evidence.applicability: closest open low-current LaB6 datum; Xe, vacuum facility, no N2/O2 plume
evidence.limitations: a demonstration setpoint, not a spot-mode minimum; no 15,000 h demonstration at this flow

evidence.value: spot mode at I_D/mdot < ~1.5 A/sccm (i.e. <= ~15 A per mg/s); tested 2-6 sccm (0.197-0.590 mg/s), 1-4 A
evidence.conditions: AHC-3.2 heaterless featherweight BaO-type cathode, diode mode, Xe, ~1e-5 Torr
evidence.applicability: indicates order of magnitude of spot-mode current per unit flow for a small cathode
evidence.limitations: 0.10 mg/s (~1.02 sccm) is BELOW the tested range; applying 1.5 A/sccm at 0.10 mg/s (~1.5 A) is extrapolation, not evidence; BaO insert, not LaB6; diode, not thruster-coupled

evidence.value: 0.02-0.1 of anode flow (range 2-7 % MaSMi; 5-10 % BHT-1500 datasheet text, verify locator)
evidence.conditions: typical Hall-thruster cathode flow fractions
evidence.applicability: ABEP anode flow ~3 mg/s delivered would give 0.06-0.2 mg/s at 2-7 % - ARITHMETIC ONLY, not a design value
evidence.limitations: fraction-of-anode rules come from Xe-anode thrusters; ABEP cathode must also survive O-bearing plume

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: A5 0.10 mg/s stays the design target; open evidence for LaB6/BaO cathodes at 1-5 A places demonstrated normal/spot operation at >= ~0.2 mg/s; no located source demonstrates <= 0.10 mg/s spot mode at the multi-ampere current a 1-1.5 kW Hall needs
parameters.what_closes_it: C-1 spot/plume boundary map (flow 0.05-0.3 mg/s x emission current at expected I_d) with thruster B-field and N2/air anode; then wear test at the chosen flow

evidence.conditions: heated start: heater 5.5 A (<28 W) for 6 min, then 150 V keeper, 2 A limit ignites
evidence.locator: cathode I-V paragraph ('The heater was supplied with 5.5 A ... for 6 minutes')
evidence.applicability: sub-kW LaB6 LUC; closest class to C-1
evidence.limitations: lab procedure; preheat for a flight profile may differ

evidence.conditions: heaterless start: time from field emission to ignition, mean 82 s; 56 s at 300 mA keeper
evidence.applicability: if C-1 were heaterless
evidence.limitations: destructive to orifice plate; keeper 150-300 mA

evidence.conditions: KM-5 life test: cathode heating time 4 min per cycle (W-Ba cathodes)
evidence.applicability: 1.35-2.5 kW Hall, closest power class with a cycle-level start
evidence.limitations: Xe flow during heating not stated

evidence.conditions: HC1 preheat ~600 s at ~45 W / ~200 s at ~60 W (already in repo AN-03)
evidence.applicability: repeat of repository evidence
evidence.limitations: not new

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: heated LaB6 preheat 200-1200 s across sources (MaSMi 360 s, KM-5 240 s, HC1 200-600 s, JPL 1.5 cm 18-20 min); discharge-ignition dwell on Xe and duration before atmospheric transfer: NO SOURCE -> TBD
parameters.what_closes_it: H-1/C-1 start sequence with logged per-phase Xe flow and time (preheat, keeper ignition, discharge ignition, dwell)

evidence.conditions: cathode Xe flow held during the 6 min heater preheat (MaSMi LUC)
evidence.applicability: direct evidence that Xe flows during preheat in a low-current LaB6 procedure
evidence.limitations: one lab procedure; 2x the A5 target

evidence.conditions: heaterless ignition flow (~10x normal), 0.98 mg/s steps
evidence.applicability: heaterless option
evidence.limitations: big per-start cost

evidence.conditions: HT5k ignition (already repo E09/AN-02)
evidence.applicability: 5 kW class
evidence.limitations: not new; out of power class

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: derived per-start CATHODE Xe (arithmetic): heated preheat 360 s x 0.20 mg/s = 72 mg; at A5 0.10 mg/s = 36 mg; heaterless 55 s x 2.9 mg/s = 0.16 g to 120 s x 3.4 mg/s = 0.41 g (56 s x 2.5 = 0.14 g). ANODE ignition Xe for a ~1 kW-class thruster: TBD (Cifali/PPS1350 does not report it)
parameters.what_closes_it: H-1 Xe discharge ignition flow and dwell measured at the H-1 accelerator; integrated Xe per start

evidence.conditions: KM-5 flight-unit requirement 'Number of on/off cycles'
evidence.applicability: scale of cycle counts for a ~1.5-2 kW Hall on GEO duty
evidence.limitations: GEO station keeping, not VLEO duty

evidence.value: 583 cycles in 1074 h (mean 1.84 h/cycle); QM 225 cycles / 554 h
evidence.conditions: KM-5 in orbit to 2007-05-28; ground QM life+qual
evidence.applicability: flight cycle-per-hour context
evidence.limitations: not an ops concept for ABEP; ABEP firing 15,000 h at that rate would be ~8,100 starts (arithmetic only)

evidence.conditions: MaSMi LUC heaterless ignitions without observable change
evidence.applicability: heaterless start qualification scale
evidence.limitations: lab

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: TBD (ops concept + FDIR); published cycle counts 10^2-10^4 are hardware demonstrations/requirements, not mission start counts
parameters.what_closes_it: VLEO ops concept (eclipse/duty cycling, anomaly restarts) and C-1 start-cycle qualification

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: TBD - no open source reports a Xe-to-air transfer duration or Xe flow profile (Cifali 2011 'smooth transition', Andreussi IEPC-2022-435 'gradually'; ESA/SITAEL 2018 press: Xe 'replaced in stages' - no times)
parameters.what_closes_it: H-1 Phase 1 transfer profile with logged Xe flow vs time

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: TBD - no published ABEP concept found that specifies a Xe fallback duration or flow
parameters.what_closes_it: owner/FDIR decision using SS-3; H-1 Xe reference point flow

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: TBD (owner, OD-XE-2); no new source; ESA 2 % residual already in mass_bom (OD-XE-4)

evidence.value: <=3.5 kg dry for 1-7 L; Ti-6Al-4V shell; D 242 mm; L <=386 mm; MEOP NOT stated
evidence.conditions: XS-XTA family, UNDER DEVELOPMENT
evidence.applicability: only located tank family sized for ~2-13 kg Xe
evidence.limitations: MEOP blank so capacity is not derivable; dry mass is an upper bound

evidence.value: 40/60/90/120 L: predicted structural mass 6.3/8.9/12.8/16.8 kg (table header 6.3-14.8 kg), max Xe 73/110/165/220 kg; MEOP 187 bar, burst x1.5
evidence.conditions: S-XTA family COPV (Ti liner, T800), UNDER DEVELOPMENT
evidence.applicability: smallest 40 L carries 73 kg - oversize for a 5-30 kg load
evidence.limitations: internal inconsistency 14.8 vs 16.8 kg at 120 L kept

evidence.value: 60 L, 11.7 kg dry, MEOP 187 bar, burst tested 456 bar
evidence.conditions: S-XTA-60 COTS, flight heritage SGEO, AMOS 6
evidence.applicability: qualified-tank anchor
evidence.limitations: Xe capacity not on this sheet (family chart: 110 kg)

evidence.conditions: tankage fraction = dry/max Xe
evidence.applicability: scale trend: fraction rises as tanks shrink
evidence.limitations: out of applicability for 5-30 kg; fractions at full load only

evidence.value: 2 L, 120 bar, CFRP on Al liner; system dry mass REQUIREMENT < 5 kg for ~3 kg Xe
evidence.conditions: Satrec 300 W Hall XFS
evidence.applicability: small-load system scale
evidence.limitations: requirement, not measured mass

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: TBD; the 5-30 kg Xe band (~3-18 L at 1.67-1.83 g/cm3) falls between XS-XTA (<=7 L, MEOP unknown) and S-XTA (>=40 L). Tankage fractions from 40-120 L tanks (0.067-0.106) are lower bounds in spirit, not transferable
parameters.what_closes_it: supplier quotation for a ~5-20 L xenon tank at declared MEOP and max temperature, or a sourced sizing model

evidence.conditions: Moog XFC: FCV + PFCV + latch valve, welded; 3-23 mg/s Xe; regulated inlet 2.4-2.8 bar (capability 186 bar); heritage AEHF, Psyche, PPE
evidence.applicability: flow control downstream of a regulator
evidence.limitations: flow range 3-23 mg/s is far above 0.1 mg/s cathode; excludes the high-pressure regulator (PMU)

evidence.conditions: Bradford Flow Control Unit (proportional + solenoid isolation valves)
evidence.applicability: flow control
evidence.limitations: flow range/pressure not stated

evidence.value: <= 0.8 kg incl. filter-getter; <= 23 W (filter-getter heater <= 17 W)
evidence.conditions: KM-5 gas distribution unit: redundant lines, electromagnetic valves, thermal throttle, throttles, Ti filter-getter at ~750 C; inlet 2.5 bar
evidence.applicability: ~1.5-2 kW Hall flow-control scale; filter-getter relevant to cathode purity
evidence.limitations: needs upstream regulator (in the SK propulsion system)

evidence.value: 450 x 380 x 220 mm module; dry < 5 kg incl. 2 L tank, bang-bang solenoid pairs, orifices, 3+ transducers, 240 cm3 accumulator, fill/vent valve
evidence.conditions: Satrec XFS for 300 W Hall (anode 4-7 sccm, cathode 0-2 sccm)
evidence.applicability: bang-bang pressure-regulation architecture at low flow
evidence.limitations: no component masses

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: TBD; integrated flow control ~0.8-1.2 kg per unit (supplier upper bounds) but at higher flows; separate regulator, latch valves, transducers, filters and lines not found with masses in open sources
parameters.what_closes_it: supplier data for a low-flow (0.05-15 mg/s) Xe feed: regulator/bang-bang PMU, latch valves, transducers, filter, fill/drain

parameters.constrained_range_or_TBD: TBD; note supercritical Xe density is strongly temperature dependent, so tank thermal control is a sizing input (see NIST data)

hardware_mass_data.note: the '1.6-1.9 g/cm3 at ~150 bar' band corresponds to 323 K vs 300 K; S-XTA 73 kg/40 L = 1.83 g/cm3 at 187 bar consistent with ~320-325 K design point (inferred). Volume for 5-30 kg at 1.67-1.83 g/cm3: ~2.7-18 L (arithmetic).
repo AN-05 ESA page: <104 kg for 900 L

unresolved: No open source demonstrates <= 0.10 mg/s LaB6 spot mode at multi-ampere Hall current (C-1 must).
Anode ignition Xe flow/dwell for a ~1 kW Hall, and any Xe-to-air transfer duration: not published in accessed sources.
Fallback Xe durations in ABEP concepts: none found.
No qualified xenon tank datasheet located in the 10-40 L range; XS-XTA MEOP blank.
Separate masses of regulator, latch valves, pressure transducers, filters, lines: not found in open datasheets.

Accept tank sizing at a stated max storage temperature (density 1.67 g/cm3 at 323 K/150 bar vs 1.97 at 300 K)?
Is a filter-getter (KM-5 style, <=17 W) in the Xe cathode line in scope, given O-sensitivity of the emitter?
Request supplier quotations (tank 5-20 L; low-flow PMU/FCU) - procurement contact is owner's call (no contact by this lane).
